seasons.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
seasons.quote: It is planted during July – August.

days_to_first_harvest.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
days_to_first_harvest.note: TNAU fertigation schedule: 120 days in total, the last 30 are the maturity stage = roots ready from about day 90.

spacing_row_cm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
spacing_row_cm.quote: ridges and furrows are formed at 30 cm apart.

spacing_plant_cm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
spacing_plant_cm.quote: Sow the seeds directly in ridges at a spacing of 10 cm.

water_need.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
water_need.quote: Irrigate the field copiously immediately after sowing and afterwards as and when necessary.
water_need.note: 'As and when necessary' is read as 'medium'. Agronomist to confirm.

waterlogging_tolerant.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
waterlogging_tolerant.quote: It comes up well in all types of friable soils.
waterlogging_tolerant.note: Friable (loose, draining) soil is needed; read as not waterlogging tolerant. Agronomist to confirm.

expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, vegetables
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.quote: The crop yields about 20-25 t/ha in 120 days.

source_notes: AI research batch 6 (2026-10-07). Ranges are stored at their lower bound unless a note says otherwise; the source range is in each quote. Sow windows are TNAU plains months (Tamil Nadu) until a Malwa source is found.
